# `collate`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Marks a given expression with the specified collation.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
collate(expr, collationName)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- collate, example 1
> SELECT COLLATION('Spark SQL' collate UTF8_LCASE);
SYSTEM.BUILTIN.UTF8_LCASE
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
